 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.409/2022 dated 18.08.2022 registered at Police Station Civil Line, District Rewa for the offence under Sections 419, 420 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Line, District Rewa
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Applicant is in detention since 26.03.2023.
2 .

As per the prosecution story on 18.08.2022 Narmadeshwar Prasad Pathak lodged an FIR alleging that on 19.05.2022 on his two mobile numbers i.e. 7974480879 and 9425185316 at around 8.30 p.m. he received a call from mobile number 8436144540 and whatsapp number 9449112211 and that person introduced himself as his old friend. The person voice appears to be the voice of his old friend Rajendra Rawat, so asked him is Rawat Babu speaking.
He replied you have identified.

However, he stated that he is in trouble as he has to receive some money in his account from Ajay Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17156181/
1 somewhere but due to some technical glitches, he is not able to receive the money in his bank account and wanted to get his phonepe number and asked him to complete the necessary procedure.

entities.text: Ajay Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After little a while he came to know that Rs.1,84,964/- has been fraudulently withdrawn from his two bank accounts i.e. one in IDBI, Rewa and second in SBI, Hanumana.

In investigation, it was found that money so withdrawn dishonestly was deposited in the bank account of present applicant Ajay Shrivastava, resident of village Thanhakhas, District -Basti whole mobile number was found to be in the name of Balok Das of West Bengal.
In investigation it was found that applicant has dishonestly and fraudulently cheated the amount of Rs.1,84,964/-.
FIR was registered after investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is ready to deposit Rs.1,90,000/- before trial Court under protest.
It is further submitted that applicant is a student.
He is innocent.
He has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated.
He himself is the victim as his bank account and mobile phone has been used by someone.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that he be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the Objector have opposed grant of bail to the applicant.
5. In this case after investigation charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant has no criminal background.
He himself is ready to deposit the cheated amount of Rs. 1,90,000/- before the trial Court.
Therefore, having taking into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without commenting on the merits of the case but I am of the view that he may be released on bail.

Hence,
bail application is allowed.

It is directed that upon depositing Rs.1,90,000/- by the applicant before the trial Court in form of fixed deposit of National Bank/ SBI which shall be encashable only as per the judgment/ orders of the trial Court.

Applicant be released on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only ) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
6.
It is made clear that the amount so deposited shall be subject to final out come of the trial Court and trial Court shall pass the order about money as per law.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
